title: After Death
overview: Pedro (Emmanuel Pianezza) is struggling to cope with the loss of his younger sister. He seeks solace in religion, convincing himself that he will see her again someday, whether in heaven or in another life. However, beneath his faith, something more primal begins to awaken... No one around him is safe anymore.
